15d_1_root_conditioning.png: The particle-number condition $\sum g f - N$ (vertical axis, of size $10^{-15}$) against $\mu$ near its root (horizontal axis, in units of $10^{-9}\,m$) for the activated state $N = 8$, $a_{4,0} = 0$, $T = 0.01$: computed directly in double precision it moves in steps of the rounding unit of $N$ (orange squares) and is zero on a whole interval, while the exact count (blue line, 40 digits) crosses zero at one point, which the balance of particles and holes finds.
